verdict.rationale: Pairing or explicit approval of a new device is a fair axis for a remote desktop tool, but the evidence pack never documents an approval prompt, pairing step, or trusted-device list gating screen view or control. The closest items are adjacent controls: a permanent password for unattended access, Server Pro's per-user/device-group access control, and 2FA. None of these is evidenced as a requirement that a new device be approved before connecting.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
